extension.name: cccc2026
extension.author: Circle City Curling
extension.description: Circle City Curling — front-end template. The home scroller and News list are driven entirely by Joomla Articles + modules (no HTML editing). Logo, brand colours and key text are set from the template Options panel.

fieldset.name: branding
fieldset.label: Branding
fieldset.description: Logo, club name and key text shown around the site. Leave a field blank to use its built-in default.

field.name: logo
field.label: Header logo
field.description: Image shown in the top-left header. If empty, the CSS-drawn club roundel is used instead. It is sized to about 118px tall.

field.name: logoDark
field.label: Header logo (dark mode)
field.description: Optional. Shown instead of the Header logo when the visitor is in dark mode (device auto-dark, or the footer light/dark toggle set to dark). Use this if your main logo has a solid light/white background — it will otherwise show as a bright box on the dark background. Leave empty to always use the Header logo in both modes.

field.name: logoFooter
field.label: Footer logo
field.description: Optional logo for the footer (which always has a dark background, independent of light/dark mode). If empty, the header logo is used; if that is also empty, the roundel is used.

field.name: logoFooterDark
field.label: Footer logo (dark mode)
field.description: Optional. Same idea as 'Header logo (dark mode)', for the footer. Leave empty to fall back to Header logo (dark mode), or to the Footer logo if that's empty too.

field.name: brandName
field.label: Club name
field.description: Text shown beside the logo in the header and footer.

field.name: tagline
field.label: Header tagline
field.description: Small line of text shown under the club name in the header.

field.name: footerCopy
field.label: Footer copyright line
field.description: Bottom-bar copyright text. Leave blank to auto-generate “© {year} {club name}. All rights reserved.” (A ‘footer’ position module, if assigned, overrides this.)

field.name: loginUrl
field.label: Member login URL
field.description: Where the Member Login button points.

fieldset.name: colours
fieldset.label: Colours
fieldset.description: Brand colours. Each maps to the matching CSS variable; leave one untouched to keep the default brand colour.

field.name: colorPrimaryDark
field.label: Primary — hover/dark
field.description: Darker shade used on hover for the primary colour.

field.name: colorAccentDark
field.label: Accent — dark
field.description: Darker shade used for the footer and nav hover states.

fieldset.name: display
fieldset.label: Display
fieldset.description: Show or hide the built-in demo blocks that appear on the Home page until you create their modules.

field.name: showPageBanner
field.label: Interior page-title banner
field.description: The styled title bar (page title + breadcrumb) shown at the top of every non-home page. Set to Hide if your articles/menu items already display their own title, to avoid showing it twice.

field.name: showPlaceholderHero
field.label: Demo hero slider
field.description: When no module is published to the ‘scroller’ position, show the built-in 3-slide demo hero. Turn off to leave the area empty until your module is live.

field.name: showPlaceholderPromo
field.label: Demo promo cards
field.description: When no modules are in the ‘promo’ position, show the three built-in demo cards.

field.name: showPlaceholderNews
field.label: Demo news item
field.description: When no module is in the ‘news’ position, show the built-in sample news row.
